english: We take you from choosing a course to applying, preparing for your English test and getting your visa for the UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland and New Zealand. A dedicated team in our Eldoret office handles each step, so you always know who is looking after you.

english: IELTS, PTE or German, in class during the day or online in the evening. Already sat IELTS elsewhere? You go straight to documentation.
kiswahili: IELTS, PTE au Kijerumani, darasani wakati wa mchana au mtandaoni jioni. Tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine? Unaruka moja kwa moja hadi nyaraka.

english: We tell you exactly which documents you need, certified by a lawyer and clearly scanned.
kiswahili: Tunakuambia hasa nyaraka unazohitaji, zikiwa zimethibitishwa na wakili na kuskaniwa vizuri.

english: Every certificate and bank statement is confirmed with whoever issued it.
kiswahili: Kila cheti na taarifa ya benki huthibitishwa na aliyekitoa.

english: We choose your course and school with you, apply, meet the offer’s conditions and get your confirmation of enrolment.
kiswahili: Tunachagua kozi na shule yako pamoja nawe, tunatuma maombi, tunatimiza masharti ya ofa na kupata uthibitisho wako wa kujiandikisha.

english: Health cover, medical examination and biometrics bookings, your visa application entered and audited, then a discounted student flight.
kiswahili: Bima ya afya, uchunguzi wa kimatibabu na miadi ya alama za vidole, ombi lako la visa kujazwa na kukaguliwa, kisha tiketi ya ndege ya wanafunzi kwa bei nafuu.

english: We help you access quality education in top destinations around the world. Choose from a wide range of countries, universities and programs.
kiswahili: Tunakusaidia kupata elimu bora katika nchi zinazoongoza duniani. Chagua kutoka nchi, vyuo vikuu na programu mbalimbali.

english: World-class universities and a relaxed, multicultural lifestyle.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya hadhi ya dunia na maisha tulivu ya tamaduni mbalimbali.

english: Respected colleges and universities in a safe, welcoming, multicultural country.
kiswahili: Vyuo na vyuo vikuu vinavyoheshimika katika nchi salama, ya kukaribisha na yenye tamaduni nyingi.

english: Tuition-friendly public universities. Our language training gets you ready.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya umma vyenye ada nafuu. Mafunzo yetu ya lugha yanakuandaa.

english: One consultancy, every step of the journey.
kiswahili: Kampuni moja ya ushauri, kila hatua ya safari.

english: Studies and Awards Limited is an educational consultancy based in Eldoret, Kenya, working with students from all over the country. We help students choose the right course and country, prepare for English tests, apply to schools, get their visas and travel.
kiswahili: Studies and Awards Limited ni kampuni ya ushauri wa elimu yenye makao Eldoret, Kenya, inayofanya kazi na wanafunzi kutoka kote nchini. Tunawasaidia wanafunzi kuchagua kozi na nchi sahihi, kujiandaa kwa mitihani ya Kiingereza, kutuma maombi shuleni, kupata visa na kusafiri.

english: To facilitate access to quality education abroad for Kenyan students, ensuring affordability, transparency, and personalised support throughout their academic journey.
kiswahili: Kuwezesha upatikanaji wa elimu bora ughaibuni kwa wanafunzi wa Kenya, kuhakikisha unafuu, uwazi na usaidizi wa kibinafsi katika safari yao yote ya masomo.

english: Affordable options so cost does not stand in the way of education.
kiswahili: Chaguo nafuu ili gharama isiwe kikwazo cha elimu.

english: Keeping up with new trends, tools and best practice in international education.
kiswahili: Kufuatilia mielekeo mipya, zana na mbinu bora katika elimu ya kimataifa.

english: Rigorous checks that protect students and partners alike.
kiswahili: Ukaguzi mkali unaowalinda wanafunzi na washirika kwa pamoja.

english: Studied abroad with us? Share your story
kiswahili: Ulisoma ughaibuni kupitia sisi? Shiriki hadithi yako

english: The questions students and parents ask us most. Anything else, call us on +254 721 796500.
kiswahili: Maswali tunayoulizwa zaidi na wanafunzi na wazazi. Kwa jingine lolote, tupigie kwa +254 721 796500.

english: Do you offer IELTS and PTE classes?
kiswahili: Je, mnatoa madarasa ya IELTS na PTE?

english: Yes. Our trainers teach IELTS and PTE in person and online, and we can also register you for the exam.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Wakufunzi wetu hufundisha IELTS na PTE ana kwa ana na mtandaoni, na tunaweza pia kukusajili kwa mtihani.

english: Can you help me with my visa?
kiswahili: Je, mnaweza kunisaidia na visa yangu?

english: Yes. Our visa team arranges your health cover, books your medical examination and biometrics appointment, fills in your visa application for you and audits it before it is submitted.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Timu yetu ya visa hupanga bima yako ya afya, huweka miadi ya uchunguzi wa kimatibabu na alama za vidole, hujaza ombi lako la visa na kulikagua kabla halijawasilishwa.

english: Which countries can I study in?
Australia, New Zealand, Ireland and Germany, as well as the United Kingdom and Canada. A counsellor will help you choose.
kiswahili: Australia, New Zealand, Ayalandi na Ujerumani, pamoja na Uingereza na Kanada. Mshauri atakusaidia kuchagua.
Je, mnasaidia na safari za ndege?

english: Yes. Through our partnership with Reserve Trip Kenya, our students can get discounted student air tickets.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Kupitia ushirikiano wetu na Reserve Trip Kenya, wanafunzi wetu wanaweza kupata tiketi za ndege za wanafunzi kwa bei nafuu.

english: Can I get help with school fees?
kiswahili: Je, naweza kupata msaada wa ada ya shule?

english: Ask us about financial support through Magister Sacco.
kiswahili: Tuulize kuhusu msaada wa kifedha kupitia Magister Sacco.

kiswahili: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, karibu na Marie Stopes Eldoret.

kiswahili: Uko tayari kuanza safari yako ughaibuni?

kiswahili: Tembelea ofisi yetu Daima Towers, Eldoret, au kutana na timu yetu mtandaoni.

kiswahili: Mwongozo wa kibinafsi kuanzia mkutano wako wa kwanza nasi hadi unapofika na kuanza masomo yako ughaibuni.

english: Every student goes through the same six steps with us, whichever of our six countries they choose. Each step has its own team in our office at Daima Towers, Eldoret, so you always know who is looking after you.
kiswahili: Kila mwanafunzi hupitia hatua zile zile sita nasi, awe amechagua nchi yoyote kati ya nchi zetu sita. Kila hatua ina timu yake katika ofisi yetu Daima Towers, Eldoret, ili ujue kila wakati ni nani anayekuhudumia.

english: Visit our office at Daima Towers in Eldoret, or meet our team online from anywhere in Kenya. We talk through your grades, budget and goals, and help you choose the country, course and school that suit you. Every member of our team gives consultations, so whoever you meet first can get you started.

Tunazungumzia alama zako, bajeti na malengo yako, na kukusaidia kuchagua nchi, kozi na shule zinazokufaa. english: The countries, courses and schools that fit them
kiswahili: Nchi, kozi na shule zinazolingana nazo

english: Whether you have already sat IELTS elsewhere. If you have the score you need, you go straight to step 3.
kiswahili: Iwapo tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine. Ukiwa na alama unazohitaji, unaruka moja kwa moja hadi hatua ya 3.

english: Any member of our team. Meet the team
kiswahili: Mwanachama yeyote wa timu yetu. Kutana na timu

english: Witney prepares you for your English test, IELTS or PTE. If you are going to Germany, Karen teaches you German. Either way, you choose how you learn.
kiswahili: Witney anakuandaa kwa mtihani wako wa Kiingereza, IELTS au PTE. Ukienda Ujerumani, Karen anakufundisha Kijerumani. Kwa vyovyote vile, wewe huchagua jinsi ya kujifunza.

english: In classAt Daima Towers, during the day
OnlineIn the evening, from wherever you are
When you are ready, we book your exam for you. If you don’t reach the score you need, you come back to class and we book your next attempt.
kiswahili: Ukiwa tayari, tunakuwekea mtihani wako. Usipofikia alama unazohitaji, unarudi darasani na tunakuwekea jaribio lako lijalo.

english: Already sat IELTS elsewhere with the score you need? Go straight to step 3
kiswahili: Tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine na una alama unazohitaji? Nenda moja kwa moja hadi hatua ya 3

english: Rahab tells you exactly which documents your application needs, and keeps them safely on file once they are in. When your documents are complete and approved, she passes your file on to our compliance team.
kiswahili: Rahab anakuambia hasa nyaraka ambazo ombi lako linahitaji, na anazihifadhi salama zikishafika. Nyaraka zako zikikamilika na kuidhinishwa, anapitisha faili yako kwa timu yetu ya utiifu.

english: Each document certified by a lawyer

Canisius and Dennis check that every document you have given us is authentic, by confirming it with whoever issued it. Only once everything has been checked does your file move on to the application team.
kiswahili: Canisius na Dennis hukagua kwamba kila hati uliyotupa ni halali, kwa kuthibitisha na aliyeitoa. Ni baada ya kila kitu kukaguliwa tu ndipo faili yako huendelea kwa timu ya maombi.

english: Certificates confirmed with the school or college that issued them
kiswahili: Vyeti vilivyothibitishwa na shule au chuo vilivyovitoa

english: Bank statements confirmed with the bank
kiswahili: Taarifa za benki zilizothibitishwa na benki

english: Every document checked before anything goes to a school
kiswahili: Kila hati hukaguliwa kabla ya chochote kutumwa shuleni

english: Joy helps you settle on the course and school that best match what you want. Once you agree, she applies for you and follows up until your offer letter arrives, conditional or unconditional.
kiswahili: Joy anakusaidia kuamua kozi na shule zinazolingana zaidi na unachotaka. Mkikubaliana, anakutumia maombi na kufuatilia hadi barua yako ya ofa ifike, iwe ya masharti au isiyo na masharti.

english: Ian makes sure every condition on your offer is met, including the documents the school asks for before it approves you (its GTE requirements). If the school asks for a statement of purpose (GSR) explaining why you want to study there, Beatrice and the GSR team write it for you. Ian then sends everything back to the school.
kiswahili: Ian huhakikisha kila sharti la ofa yako linatimizwa, ikiwemo nyaraka ambazo shule huomba kabla ya kukuidhinisha (mahitaji yake ya GTE). Shule ikiomba taarifa ya madhumuni (GSR) inayoeleza kwa nini unataka kusoma huko, Beatrice na timu ya GSR wanakuandikia. Kisha Ian hutuma kila kitu kurudi shuleni.

english: When the school approves you, Winnie, our application manager, makes sure your fees are paid and your confirmation of enrolment (CoE) is issued. Winnie oversees every application from start to finish.
kiswahili: Shule ikikuidhinisha, Winnie, meneja wetu wa maombi, huhakikisha ada yako imelipwa na uthibitisho wako wa kujiandikisha (CoE) umetolewa. Winnie husimamia kila ombi kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho.

english: Mourine and Joyner take care of every part of your visa application, from your health cover to your biometrics.
kiswahili: Mourine na Joyner hushughulikia kila sehemu ya ombi lako la visa, kuanzia bima yako ya afya hadi alama zako za vidole.

english: Visa data entry: your application form filled in for you
kiswahili: Uingizaji wa data ya visa: fomu yako ya maombi hujazwa kwa ajili yako

english: Visa audit: the whole application checked, your statement of purpose included, before it is submitted
kiswahili: Ukaguzi wa visa: ombi zima hukaguliwa, pamoja na taarifa yako ya madhumuni, kabla ya kuwasilishwa
Miadi ya alama za vidole imewekwa

english: Once your visa is granted, Mourine books your flight at a discounted student fare.
kiswahili: Visa yako ikishatolewa, Mourine anakukatia tiketi ya ndege kwa nauli nafuu ya wanafunzi.
